newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice futures end quiet session mixed.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice futures end quiet session mixed.

text.p: CBOT rice futures ended a dull session mixed on Tuesday but concerns were growing that a late monsoon season in India would cut production there, pit sources said.
"Everyone is watching the monsoon season in India," one trader said. "If it gets delayed much more they may have some crop problems."

India's monsoon rains, which normally hit the southwestern tip of the subcontinent around June 1, were likely to arrive about a week late this year, Indian meteorological department officials said on Tuesday.
CBOT rice futures ended down two cents per cwt to up three with July unchanged at $11.66 per cwt.
Volume was estimated by CBOT at 200 lots, compared with Monday's actual volume of 327 lots.
